title: DR. BIAS: SOCIAL DISPARITIES IN AI-POWERED MEDICAL GUIDANCE

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing readability metrics, sentiment, and linguistic complexity of LLM-generated medical advice across male, female, and intersex patient profiles.
Analyzing disparities in response readability, length, sentiment, and medical emergency assessment in advice generated for seven different US Census ethnic groups.
Varying patient profile descriptions across four age categories (child, teen, adult, senior) to generate and evaluate differences in LLM medical advice.
Measuring the compounded effects and amplified disparities in model responses (e.g., readability, sentiment polarity) when explicitly combining sex and ethnic identities in patient profiles.
